title: Architecture overview
description: Bahi in the cloud connects through the Windows connector to TallyPrime on the computer.

title: Windows connector components
description: The user screen delegates background work to the sync engine, which records progress locally and uses separate Bahi and Tally connections.

title: Master sync user workflow
description: Connect, choose a direction, load records, match, preview, confirm, transfer and review results.

title: Link existing masters
description: The user confirms a pair of existing master records, which are rechecked and linked locally without remote modification.

title: Successful master transfer
description: Save durable intent and the write attempt, send the approved master, read back the target and record verified completion.

title: Uncertain master write recovery
description: Investigate a possibly applied create; record verified recovery or keep uncertainty visible without automatically creating again.

title: Master operation states
description: Normal progress from pending to verified success, with blocked work, conflicts and reconciliation of uncertain writes.
